name: TravelerDutyOfCareMonitor
tagline: Know where every traveller is, who is affected and who is safe – in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete corporate-travel duty-of-care app for Power Apps and Power Pages: live traveller list by location and risk level, incident impact, check-in requests and responses with response windows, escalation with notes and tiered manager/security approvals for high-risk destinations. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list or the Power Pages Web API.
features: Incident impact matching by city/country and departure window
One-click check-in round for all affected travellers
Welfare workflow with allowed transitions, response window and overdue flags
Escalation and resolution with required notes
Risk-tiered approvals (manager, security) with rejection reasons
Drag & drop and keyboard board moves
controlType: standard (2 controls: TravelerDutyOfCareMonitor data set + TravelerDutyOfCareMonitorPortal field control)
